execution: long only, 1x: the index ETF itself (signal and execution on the same ticker)
bars: daily, yfinance auto_adjust=False (split-adjusted price return) in the evidence; see total_return.json

signal.flush: close <= mean(close, 5) - 1.5 x ATR14 AND low < min(low of the prior 20 bars)
signal.trigger: the first up-close (close > previous close) within 5 sessions after the flush bar
signal.decision: at the signal bar's close; order for the NEXT session's open

entry: next session open (signal bar i -> entry bar i+1); a signal while in a position on the ticker is ignored
stop: lowest low from the flush bar through the signal bar (index level = ETF level at 1x); skip if the stop is not below the entry open or risk < 0.25% of entry
take_profit: entry + K* x risk, K* per ticker below (TP doctrine: calibrated on the first 60% of that ticker's no-TP trades, never 50)
fills: stop / TP tested on the ETF's own daily high/low; a gap through a level fills at the open; stop and TP in one bar -> stop first
cost_model: 5.0 bps slippage per side, no commission, ETF price series (expense embedded)
caveats: price return in the evidence (distributions not added back): total_return.json reads the effect
